verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS data warehouse with local clients, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented setting to disable telemetry or usage tracking. SaaS Mode only limits MotherDuck's access to the local environment, which is an adjacent control, and the fully offline UI mode is only described by a community user as being considered, not shipped.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
